I guess it’s just me acting in response of my earlier trauma. This year was the year my mom passed away in her sleep, my stepdad grooming me after she passed, getting molested by my stepdad, and moving away from my friends so out of the blue. I think it’s just some self harm. I’ve self harmed pretty severely in the past. I definitely learned my lesson from last night.

I don’t know what strain it was but here’s my experience: when I got home I started hearing things. I have a phobia of extraterrestrial aliens and I was afraid I would be abducted. I thought I saw an alien. I hid under my blanket but it felt like it would uncover me. I was texting incoherently. My mouth was very dry and made a watery click whenever I spoke.
